description: Colombo Municipal Council - The Budget document for the Year - 2024 for the Colombo Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the public inspection period for the Colombo Municipal Council's 2024 budget. This falls under public sector administration and service matters, specifically related to local government financial operations and public accountability procedures, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8). It does not involve government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or detailed portfolio assignments that would qualify for Types 1-3, nor does it fit the specialized categories of land, legal, commercial, elections, or judicial matters.
